name: Glass teleprompter
oneLiner: a glass teleprompter with the camera lens glowing through the mirror: the script rolls up past the red read markers, the line on the read band lights white while the rest dim, a cursor taps plus three times and the speed ticks up as the scroll quickens
say: when the speaker says they read from a script or a teleprompter ('I write every word first', 'the script rolls while I talk to the lens'): the lines roll while they set it up, the speed taps land if they say they speed it up
